checks: Missing, naive, expired source context rejected before model load or pixel read
Future capture rejected; stale unreviewed review cannot be revived by editing metadata
Unreviewed photo/package expire at capture+7d or original cap, whichever earlier
Approval makes a byte-identical separate image and reviewed package, never extends original unreviewed image
Approved copy and encrypted outbox inherit min capture+90d and original cap
Source cap transmitted only in actual approval payload, inherited by server observation
Expired queued source cannot make an HTTP request
Diagnostic analysis JSON and bound generated PNGs are recognized by cleanup
Changed hashes, outside-folder paths, junctions and legacy metadata refused; unrelated source files preserved
Actual isolated workflow UI and scoped report followed by privacy deletion and local queue/photo revocation
limits: Local future-expiry unit cases use explicit simulated clocks; server cap expiry elapsed-time HTTP evidence is maintained separately by backend tests.
The 600-second soak and historical CPU/CUDA benchmark precede this policy fix and are not retroactively claimed to include it.
No field privacy acceptance or model accuracy is established.
Unclassified legacy or interrupted artifacts require operator review; the tool does not guess their capture/deadline.
